title: Preserve the original fixture observer assertion when a held StateInner mutex is poisoned
outcome: A failed fixture observer control cleans up its writer and reports its original discriminating failure even when the held disposable StateInner guard unwinds.
acceptance: A deterministic panic while the control owns its disposable StateInner guard is cleaned up without leaking the writer thread and without replacing the original panic with a shutdown poison panic.
Reuse existing fixture/StateMutex shutdown mechanisms in test-only scope and run focused cleanup plus the existing observer controls; do not alter production poison or shutdown policy.
